notes: Zenit Tracker — CleverTap 2.0 analytics schema. Event names are SNAKE_CASE; properties are camelCase. Timestamps are epoch ms ($D_<epoch>). `source` = B2B <partner> | D2C <plan>. No CleverTap API key required — events persist to Firestore `analytics_events` and forward to CleverTap when credentials are configured.

App_Launched.triggered: When the app loads / first paint

Login.triggered: When the user clicks sign-in AND when they successfully log in (email + Google)

Logout.triggered: When the user is logged out

Searched.triggered: When a keyword is entered and searched (global AI / bug search)

Content_Clicked.triggered: When the user clicks a test case, bug, or session

Test_Case_Executed.triggered: When a tester marks a test case Pass / Fail / N/A / Untested / Fail (Known)

Test_Case_Created.triggered: When a new test case is authored

Test_Case_Edited.triggered: When an existing test case is modified

Session_Started.triggered: When a test session / run begins

Session_Completed.triggered: When a test session / run finishes

Bug_Reported.triggered: When a new bug is filed

Bug_Resolved.triggered: When a bug is resolved / closed

PRD_Uploaded.triggered: When a PRD document is imported

Test_Case_Generated.triggered: When AI generates test cases from a PRD

Export_Downloaded.triggered: When a CSV / XLSX export is downloaded

Media_Error.triggered: When a client error occurs (captured with error message)

conventions.contentType: test_case | bug | session | suite | prd | report | dashboard
